title: Isolation of human and murine hematopoietic stem cells for DNA damage and DNA repair assays
protocol: Centrifuge the whole bone marrow sample in a 15 mL conical tube at 2000 × g at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Remove the plasma with a pipette without disturbing the cells.
Take 2 mL of bone marrow (after plasma removal) in a 50 mL tube and add 8 mL of ammonium chloride solution.
Mix well with a pipette.
Incubate for 10–15 minutes on ice.
Wash by directly adding 40 mL of 1× PBS to the mixture and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant.
Repeat washing until the cell pellet appears white or with very few red cells, typically requiring 2 more times.
Add 4 mL of ammonium chloride directly to the cells and incubate for 5–10 minutes on ice during each repeat wash.
Wash every incubation of ammonium chloride by adding 40 mL of 1× PBS and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant after each wash.
Resuspend the MNC pellet in 1 mL EasySep Buffer.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 5 mL FACS tube.
Add 50 μL of human progenitor cell enrichment cocktail for every 1 mL of cell suspension.
Mix with a pipette and incubate for 15 min at 18°C–21°C.
Add 50 μL of magnetic particles for every 1 mL of cell suspension.
Mix with a pipette and incubate for another 15 min at 18°C–21°C.
Add 2.5 mL EasySep Buffer to the tube containing cells.
Place the tube in the EasySep Magnet and incubate for 15 min at 18°C–21°C.
Keep the tube in the magnet and pour out the supernatant into a new tube.
The supernatant contains the Lin- cells, which are ready for further analyses.
Euthanize mice (8–10 weeks old) in a CO2 chamber using 2 liters per minute CO2 for 5 minutes.
Place the euthanized mouse in a ventral position and spray it with 70% ethanol to sterilize.
Remove the muscles and tissue around the legs using a scalpel.
Make a cut in the pelvic-hip joint to collect the femur and tibia.
Use paper napkins along with a scalpel to remove any remaining muscular tissue surrounding the femur and tibia.
Cut the femur and tibia at both ends.
Fill a 10 mL syringe with HBSS++ flushing media using a 27-gauge needle.
Insert the needle into the hollow opening of the bone and flush the bone marrow into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Continue to flush until the bone looks transparent/white.
Make a single cell suspension by pipetting up and down with a 10 mL pipette.
Mix the cells using a BD 10 mL eccentric tip syringe and BD 18G 1 inch needle.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer into a clean 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 600 μL of column buffer.
Mix with a pipette.
Add 150 μL of the Lineage biotin antibody cocktail.
Incubate 15 min on ice.
Mix with a pipette.
Add 450 μL of column buffer, then add 300 μL of the anti-biotin microbeads.
Mix with a pipette and incubate 15 min on ice.
Wash by adding 10 mL of column buffer.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Set up the LS column and MidiMACS separator on the MACS MultiStand.
Place a 15 mL conical tube underneath the LS column.
Add 1 mL of column buffer to the LS column and allow it to flow through into the 15 mL conical tube by gravity flow.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL column buffer.
Add the resuspended cells to the LS column.
Wash the column twice with 1 mL of column buffer.
Elute Lin+ cells by adding 1 mL column buffer to the column and using the plunger to expel the cells into a new 15 mL conical tube.
Resuspend enriched Lin- cells in 1 mL of HBSS++.
Count resuspended Lin- cells.
Take 1.5×10^5 to 2×10^5 Lin- cells for each single-color control and resuspend them in 100 μL of HBSS++.
Add 2.5 μL of each biotin-labeled lineage antibody to the PE single-color control sample.
Add 25 μL of each biotin-labeled lineage antibody to each experimental sample.
Add 2.5 μL of fluorochrome-conjugated antibody to the corresponding single-color control.
Add 25 μL of fluorochrome-conjugated antibody to each experimental sample.
Incubate on ice for 30 min.
Add 10 mL of HBSS++ to both the single-color controls and the experimental samples.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant from the single-color controls and experimental samples.
Resuspend the single-color controls in 100 μL HBSS++.
Resuspend the experimental samples in 1 mL HBSS++.
Add 1 μL of the PE-streptavidin antibody to the PE single-color control.
Add 7 μL of the PE-secondary antibody to the experimental samples.
Incubate on ice for 20 min.
Add 10 mL of HBSS++ to the single-color controls and experimental samples.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the experimental samples in 500 μL HBSS++.
Resuspend the single-color controls in 200 μL HBSS++.
Filter the samples using a 5 mL round bottom tube with cell strainer cap (mesh size 35 μm).
Place the samples on ice and proceed to FACS sorting.
Collect the samples in 500 μL of collection media.
The sorted samples are ready for downstream applications.
Thaw MethoCult H4434 Classic (for human samples) or MethoCult GF M3434 (for mouse samples) and bring up to 37°C in a water bath.
Adjust the cell concentration of Lin- cells to 10,000 viable cells per 100 μL in StemSpan SFEM II culture medium or HBSS++.
Adjust the cell concentration of CD34+ cells or LSK cells to 2,000 viable cells per 100 μL in StemSpan SFEM II culture medium or HBSS++.
For every 3 mL of MethoCult H4434 Classic or MethoCult GF M3434, add 30 μL of PenStrep and 100 μL of the adjusted cell suspension.
Vortex the cell suspension for 5–10 s after adding the components.
If applicable, add any experimental drug to the mixture before vortexing.
Thaw each MethoCult aliquot at 37°C in a water bath right before use.
Let the culture cell suspension stand for 5 min or until bubbles disappear.
Distribute 1 mL of methylcellulose per well in a 6-well SmartDish slowly to avoid bubble formation.
Repeat distribution with remaining 2 mL of methylcellulose for the other wells.
Incubate cells at 37°C for 14 days for human CFU assay or 7 days for mouse CFU assay.
Place the SmartDish in a humid chamber prepared with sterile water to prevent evaporation.
Spin down the cells onto SuperFrost Plus slides.
Set up the cytofunnel assembly.
Pipette 1.5×10^5 - 2×10^5 cells resuspended in 50 μL of PBS into each funnel.
Place the assembly in the cytocentrifuge.
Run at 500 × g for 5 min.
Remove the funnel assembly from the cytocentrifuge and disassemble.
Draw a circle on the back side of the microscope slide to indicate where the cells have been spun onto the slide.
Use a hydrophobic pen to draw a border around the cells.
Allow slides to dry completely (approximately 2 min).
Prepare 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) by diluting the stock solution in PBS.
Add approximately 750 μL of 4% PFA to each sample.
Incubate for 15 min at 18°C–21°C.
Tap off PFA from the slides.
Wash samples twice with PBS, 5 min each.
Add enough ice cold methanol to cover each sample (∼200 μL).
Incubate for 2 min at 18°C–21°C.
Wash samples twice with PBS, 5 min each.
Prepare fresh blocking buffer filtered through a 0.45 μm filter.
Add 500 μL of blocking buffer to each sample.
Incubate for 1 h at 18°C–21°C.
Prepare fresh IF buffer.
Dilute anti-phospho-Histone H2A.X antibody 1:1000 in IF buffer.
Add approximately 100 μL of diluted antibody to each sample.
Incubate at 4°C in a humid chamber for 12–18 h.
Incubate the slides at 37°C for 1 h after overnight incubation.
Wash samples three times with PBS, 5 min each.
Dilute secondary antibody (donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488) 1:500 in IF buffer.
Add approximately 100 μL of diluted secondary antibody to each sample.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 h in a humid chamber.
Wash samples twice with PBS, 5 min each.
Dry the slide such that all excess PBS is cleared off.
Add a drop of ProLong Gold Antifade Mountant with DAPI over the cells.
Place glass coverslip on top, ensuring no bubbles and complete coverage by mounting solution.
Seal edges of the coverslips with clear nail polish.
Let dry at 18°C–21°C for approximately 15 minutes.
Image cells immediately or store at 4°C until ready to be imaged.
Image the cells using a FITC filter at either 40× or 63× magnification.
Melt LMAgarose in boiling water for 5 minutes with the cap loosened.
Place the bottle containing melted LMAgarose into a 37°C water bath for at least 20 minutes to cool.
Maintain LMAgarose at 37°C after melting to prevent solidification.
Combine 1000 cells with 50 μL of LMAgarose (at 37°C).
Immediately pipette the cell suspension onto a CometSlide.
Avoid formation of bubbles on the slide.
Place slides flat at 4°C in the dark for 10 min.
Immerse slides in pre-chilled Lysis Solution and incubate for 12–18 h at 4°C.
Drain excess buffer from slides.
Immerse slides in freshly prepared Alkaline Unwinding Solution.
Incubate the slides in Alkaline Unwinding Solution for 1 hour at 4°C in the dark.
Pour the Alkaline Electrophoresis Solution into an electrophoresis chamber.
Carefully immerse the slides and align them equidistant from the chamber electrodes.
Set the power supply to 21 V.
Perform electrophoresis for 30 minutes.
Drain excess electrophoresis solution.
Gently wash slides 2 times for 5 minutes in deionized water.
Wash slides once with 70% ethanol for 5 minutes.
Dry samples at 37°C for 10–15 minutes.
Store slides at 18°C–21°C until ready to image.
Add 100 μL of the diluted SYBR Green solution onto each circle of dried agarose.
Stain slides for 30 minutes at 18°C–21°C.
Tap the slide gently to remove excess SYBR Green solution.
Rinse the slide in water.
Allow the slides to dry completely at 37°C.
View the slides using an epifluorescence microscope.
